desc: Derive and validate the per-number reduction count \(d(x)=\lfloor\log_4 x\rfloor+1\), including powers of four.
Implement an \(O(\log_4 10^9)\) prefix-sum function for total reduction work on \([1,n]\).
Prove that the minimum number of two-element operations is \(\lceil\text{total required selections}/2\rceil\), including the dominant-workload case.
Implement `minOperations` using range work via prefix differences and Python integer arithmetic.
Test both examples and edge cases crossing powers of four, including ranges with equal reduction depths.
